inputs.text: The real issue is whether Alberta’s government will put water and affected communities ahead of coal-industry interests. Calling a demand for a ban on coal exploration “ideology” dismisses legitimate concerns about protecting shared resources; “balanced development” can become a cover for letting powerful extractive interests set the terms. Elected leaders have a responsibility to protect people and the land, not just defend a resource economy at any cost.

subtopics: Elected leaders’ responsibility to protect people and land
